fusions.name: Spore Flick
fusions.desc: Spits a spore that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Puffball Ring
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 10 damage and is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Sentinel Cap
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a cap beside you for 20 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 6 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds, each with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Creeping Bloom
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance.
